target_reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, "Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-mm level vibration," Proc. of ACM IMWUT, 2021.
paper_level_summary_zh: 本文在引言和第七节相关工作A部分中，将目标论文[15]作为通过RFID进行穿墙窃听的代表性工作引用，说明RFID穿墙感知能力引发的隐私问题。

evidences.evidence_quote: researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17].
evidences.evidence_context: In addition, researchers have demonstrated the feasibility of using commodity RFID devices for through-wall eavesdropping [15, 17]. Thus, it is crucial to implement privacy measures to secure RFID sensing systems.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, "Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via rfid by capturing sub-mm level vibration," Proc. of ACM IMWUT, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 正文明确将[15]作为RFID穿墙窃听可行性的证据，属于能力认可，但未特别强调亚毫米级精度。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 本文指出，已有研究[15]展示了利用商用RFID设备进行穿墙窃听的可行性。

evidences.evidence_quote: Numerous studies have shown successful attempts in through-wall human motion [3–5] and speech eavesdropping [15–18] via RFID tags for adversarial uses.
evidences.evidence_context: However, the widespread adoption of low-cost RFID tags and the richness of their sensing capabilities, particularly their through-wall sensing ability, render non-negligible privacy concerns [13–15]. Numerous studies have shown successful attempts in through-wall human motion [3–5] and speech eavesdropping [15–18] via RFID tags for adversarial uses.

evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 此处[15]与其他文献一起作为普遍背景引用，未提供具体细节，属于普通相关工作列举。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 本文在引言中列举了通过RFID进行穿墙人动检测和语音窃听的多项研究，其中包括文献[15]。
